_readme: Monetization settings. Everything here is optional; empty values fall back to honest placeholders. See README.md → 'Zarada / Monetization'. Never commit secret API keys here: this file is published as part of a static site.

newsletter._help: provider: none | buttondown | mailchimp | beehiiv | other. When action_url is empty the form opens a pre-filled email to contact_email (demo mode). Paste the PUBLIC form action URL from your provider to switch to real sign-ups.

ads._help: Paste a raw HTML snippet from your ad network or a direct-sold banner into a slot. Empty slot = house ad linking to the advertising page. Slots: in_article (before the 3rd section of every article), sidebar (article rail, category and archive pages), home_band (homepage, below markets).

subscription._help: Display text only. The real charge comes from the Stripe Price in the Vercel env var STRIPE_PRICE_ID; the API refuses to start Checkout unless that price is exactly 7.00 EUR per month (see api/lib.js EXPECTED_*). Secret keys live ONLY in Vercel env vars, never here.
